scenarios_evaluated.scenario_topic: Financial Regulatory Compliance vs Capital Mobility

competing_narratives.text_statement: Structuring cash transactions under 31 U.S.C. 5324 undermines banking transparency and triggers mandatory audit scrutiny.
Private capital transfers between individuals should remain confidential without mandatory government reporting thresholds.

scenarios_evaluated.statistical_tilt_explanation: Perspective 'Strict Statutory Oversight' is weighted 1.0x more heavily due to greater entity density (3 vs 3 KG matches). Training data currently exhibits an institutional compliance bias.

scenarios_evaluated.scenario_topic: Corporate Governance Oversight vs Founder Discretion

competing_narratives.text_statement: Independent board oversight and shareholder quorum voting protect corporate solvency and prevent unauthorized asset transfers.
Founders must retain unilateral operational authority to move capital rapidly without bureaucratic board delays.

scenarios_evaluated.statistical_tilt_explanation: Perspective 'Fiduciary Board Control' is weighted 1.0x more heavily due to greater entity density (2 vs 2 KG matches). Training data currently exhibits an institutional compliance bias.
